significance: A Shvetambara Jain tirtha in the Dhar district of Madhya Pradesh, founded in 1884 by Acharya Rajendrasuri and dedicated to the first Tirthankara Rishabhanatha. It grew into a major pilgrimage centre around the acharya's memorial.
story: Acharya Rajendrasuri is said to have looked on the quiet land here and foretold that it would rise in holiness and become a great tirtha.
